notes: «قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا وهم» is the compiler's own remark and is not a link.

«وقد روي النهى عن الخذف عن عبد الله بن بريدة عن عبد الله بن مغفل» gives another route for the same prohibition: written as a variant group. It is read as a variant of the same ruling, not as a second saying; if the archive reads it as a second saying it falls under rule 11.
